sources.title: Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang as CEO
sources.excerpt: Nov 23 (Reuters) - Nvidia on Monday said it is reinstating Jensen Huang as chief executive, effective immediately. Nvidia shares surged on the news, jumping more than 25% in premarket trading. The company’s move to bring Huang back marks a sharp reversal from its board’s decision just days earlier to rule out his return. Huang built Nvidia from a video-game chip designer into the dominant supplier of AI processors, steering its chip roadmap, customer deals and Washington ties along the way. He resigned on November 12 after revelations of extramarital affairs, including one with a businesswoman US authorities suspect of spying for China, an allegation Beijing denies. The board said it was satisfied with Huang’s candor and leadership ability and, after receiving input from senior U.S. government officials, saw no national security risk in his return.
sources.limits: Reuters稿件经Investing.com转载；报道中的指控属于媒体转述，未在本稿扩展为已证实事实。

sources.title: NVIDIA Board Reinstates Jensen Huang as President, CEO and Board Director
sources.excerpt:
NVIDIA (NASDAQ: NVDA) today announced that effective immediately, Jensen Huang has been reinstated as President and Chief Executive Officer and as a member of the Board. The Board of Directors voted unanimously to reinstate Mr. Huang following a series of discussions and meetings with Mr. Huang, after which the Board was satisfied with respect to Mr. Huang’s candor and ability to lead NVIDIA. In the process of reaching its decision, the Board received input from senior levels of the United States government, and based on that input, the Board is confident that Mr. Huang’s reinstatement poses no national security risk.

“The Board believes Jensen is the right person to lead NVIDIA, and that his reinstatement is in the best interests of our stockholders, employees, partners and customers,” said Harvey C. Jones, Chair of the Board.
sources.limits: 公告仅标注日期，未显示发布时间；对董事会决策理由按公司自述归因。

sources.title: Singapore, China reach 29 deals at top bilateral forum, the highest in recent years
sources.excerpt: Singapore and China concluded 29 deals in areas ranging from trade and finance to science and technology and public health at their top bilateral forum on Nov 23 – the highest number in recent years. Deputy Prime Minister Gan Kim Yong, who co-chairs the Joint Council for Bilateral Cooperation (JCBC) with Chinese Vice-Premier Ding Xuexiang, witnessed the signing of these agreements after the meetings. Both sides also discussed ways to refresh the three flagship government-to-government projects in line with this year’s JCBC theme, Innovating Together for New Opportunities. The projects are the Suzhou Industrial Park, the Tianjin Eco-City and the Chongqing Connectivity Initiative.
sources.limits: 单一独立媒体报道；报道中的协议数量及内容未逐项与两国官方清单交叉核对。

sections.title: 人事变化与市场反应
paragraphs: Reuters称，黄仁勋即刻复任CEO，盘前股价上涨逾25%；英伟达公告进一步确认他同时恢复总裁和董事身份。公告称柯莱特·克雷斯结束临时CEO安排、继续担任CFO。股价反应是当时市场表现，不等同于对公司治理或经营风险的长期判断。

sections.title: 治理影响取决于调查与合规安排
paragraphs: 这次逆转把领导权重新交还联合创始人，但董事会公告同时称，针对近期报道所涉外国情报活动的独立董事调查仍将继续，并设立国家安全与出口管制委员会、招聘首席合规官。因而，短期市场欢迎回归与长期治理审视并存；后续判断应看调查是否完成、合规负责人是否到位以及公司对政府调查的配合进展，而不是把单日涨幅当作风险解除证据。上述安排为公司公告所述，调查对象及背景报道不在此作独立事实认定。

stories.title: 新加坡与中国年度合作理事会达成29项成果，推进自贸协定升级讨论
stories.status: Pi自动生成 · 未经人工逐条核验
stories.takeaway: 中新联合理事会第22次会议宣布29项合作成果，涉及贸易、金融、科技、公共卫生及人员往来；双方还讨论升级中新自贸协定。协议数量显示议程广泛，但具体经贸效果仍取决于后续谈判和落实。

sections.title: 合作议程涵盖经贸与公共服务
paragraphs: 报道列出29项成果，包含续签服务贸易合作备忘录、创新合作，以及公共卫生和人文交流；新加坡食品局批准海南冷冻及冷藏禽肉、猪肉和禽蛋输新。双方还讨论自贸协定升级，颜金勇称工作可能需一至两年。上述是已报道的会议成果与讨论，不能视为协定升级已经完成。

sections.title: 成果数量不等于即时贸易增量
paragraphs: 29项成果说明合作议题覆盖面扩大，但其中既有审批、续签，也有仍在讨论的安排。例如，快速支付系统的小额转账联通在报道中仍属讨论事项；自贸协定升级也尚待谈判。评估实质影响应区分已生效的许可与备忘录、待谈判条款及后续执行数据。
